title: The Birth of Isaac
image_prompt: Joyful elderly Sarah seated in a warmly lit desert tent holding newborn infant Isaac wrapped in clean linen swaddling clothes, elderly Abraham beside her smiling in profound gratitude and wonder, golden afternoon sunbeam filtering through tent door.

title: Hagar and Ishmael Depart
image_prompt: Early dawn outside the encampment: sorrowful Abraham placing a leather waterskin strap over weeping Hagar's shoulder and handing bread to adolescent Ishmael, gesturing into the misty desert horizon with a heavy heart.

title: The Well of Water in Beersheba
image_prompt: Desolate sun-bleached wilderness of Beersheba: weeping Hagar seated under a dry desert shrub looking up in awe at a radiant angel pointing her toward a pristine bubbling spring of clear water nearby.

title: Journey to Mount Moriah
image_prompt: Abraham and young Isaac walking up a winding rocky desert path with a pack donkey loaded with split wood, Isaac carrying bundles of firewood on his back, distant rugged mountain peaks framed against a dramatic morning sky.

title: The Altar on the Mount
image_prompt: Dramatic mountain summit of Moriah: rustic stone altar with neatly laid wood, young Isaac lying bound atop the wood in peaceful submission, Abraham with trembling hand and agonizing faith raising the bronze blade toward the sky.

title: The Ram in the Thicket
image_prompt: Divine golden celestial light breaking through storm clouds onto the mountain peak, Abraham embracing freed Isaac in tears of relief, pointing toward a majestic horned ram caught firmly by its horns in a thorny briar bush.

title: Purchase of the Cave of Machpelah
image_prompt: Ancient city gate of Hebron: grieving Abraham weighing out bright silver shekels to Ephron before Hittite elders, background showing the ancient arched limestone entrance of the sacred Cave of Machpelah surrounded by olive trees.

title: Abraham's Oath to Eliezer
image_prompt: Interior of patriarchal tent: frail aged Abraham placing the hand of his faithful chief steward Eliezer under his thigh, administering a solemn sacred oath to seek a bride for Isaac from his ancestral homeland.

title: Rebekah at the Well of Nahor
image_prompt: Golden hour at ancient stone town well outside city of Nahor: graceful young Rebekah in modest linen robe lowering a clay water jar from her shoulder to give drink to weary traveler Eliezer, while ten thirsty camels kneel at stone watering troughs.

title: Rebekah Departs for Canaan
image_prompt: Rebekah adorned with gleaming gold nose ring and matching bracelets, waving farewell to brother Laban and mother outside stone courtyard, mounting a laden travel camel with her handmaids to begin the long journey.

title: Isaac Meets Rebekah in the Field
image_prompt: Sweeping twilight meadow at Beersheba: young meditative Isaac walking alone in evening prayer, looking up to see approaching camel caravan; gracefully draped Rebekah stepping down from camel and veiling her face in modest beauty.

title: The Burial of Abraham
image_prompt: Solemn twilight burial at the Cave of Machpelah: mature Isaac and Ishmael standing side by side in brotherly reconciliation, carrying the shroud-wrapped body of 175-year-old Abraham into the limestone tomb chamber amidst flickering torches.

title: The Birth of Esau and Jacob
image_prompt: Birth tent scene: midwives holding newborn twins wrapped in linen—the firstborn covered in thick reddish hair, and the second smooth baby's tiny hand firmly grasping his brother's heel; Isaac and Rebekah watching with awe.

title: The Sale of the Birthright
image_prompt: Campfire inside a tent: exhausted muscular hunter Esau in rugged animal skins throwing down bow and empty quiver, begging desperately for a steaming clay bowl of thick red lentil stew stirred by calm, calculating Jacob.

title: Isaac Reopens the Wells
image_prompt: Vast sunlit valley of Gerar: Isaac's servants lifting heavy stone covers from ancient silted wells, crystal-clear water gushing into stone irrigation channels amidst lush hundredfold fields of golden wheat.

title: Rebekah Overhears Isaac
image_prompt: Split panel view: inside tent, blind infirm Isaac resting on pillows requesting hunted venison from bearded Esau; outside tent curtain, Rebekah listening intently in shadows and urgently gesturing young Jacob to come.

title: Jacob Disguised in Goat Skins
image_prompt: Rebekah carefully fastening soft hairy goatskins around smooth wrists and neck of hesitant Jacob, handing him a freshly cooked bowl of savory roasted goat meat and flatbread in the dimly lit tent.

title: The Stolen Blessing
image_prompt: Intimate high-tension scene: blind old Isaac leaning forward to feel the hairy goatskin covering Jacob's outstretched wrist, raising his right hand in profound prophetic blessing over kneeling Jacob, divine golden aura.

title: Esau's Bitter Anguish
image_prompt: Esau returning with freshly roasted venison, falling to his knees on tent rugs with hands clasped to face in weeping fury, as trembling Isaac realizes the deception and looks away in dismay.

title: Jacob's Ladder at Bethel
image_prompt: Solitary starlit wilderness plateau: Jacob sleeping on bare ground with head resting on stone pillar, supernatural stairway of pure radiant celestial light stretching up into cosmos with luminous winged angels ascending and descending.

title: The Pillar Anointed at Bethel
image_prompt: Dawn breaking over Bethel: Jacob standing with reverent fear beside the upright sleeping-stone, tilting a clay cruse of golden olive oil and pouring it smoothly over the pillar's crown in solemn vow to God.

title: Jacob Rolls Away the Well Stone
image_prompt: Ancient pasture well surrounded by three flocks of sheep: young powerful Jacob gripping and single-handedly levering a massive round stone slab off the well mouth to water the flock of lovely approaching shepherdess Rachel.

title: Jacob Serves Seven Years for Rachel
image_prompt: Lush pastoral landscape of Haran: Jacob tenderly greeting weeping Rachel by the water cistern; split montage showing Jacob diligently shepherding white sheep under changing seasons with enduring devotion.

title: Laban's Wedding Deception
image_prompt: Morning sunlight entering wedding tent: stunned Jacob throwing back his blanket in shock and anger upon discovering heavily veiled older sister Leah beside him, confronting cunning uncle Laban standing at tent doorway.

title: The Sons of Jacob
image_prompt: Vibrant bustling nomadic family encampment in Haran: Leah, Rachel, Bilhah, and Zilpah tending to a lively crowd of young growing boys playing with wooden shepherd toys under shade trees, burgeoning twelve tribes.

title: The Birth of Joseph
image_prompt: Beautiful Rachel radiant in emotional tears, cradling newborn baby Joseph against her chest in a cozy pastoral tent, lifting her eyes toward heaven in joyous thanksgiving.

title: Jacob's Flocks Flourish
image_prompt: Jacob standing triumphantly by watering troughs carved from stone, peeling white bark strips from poplar and almond rods, surrounded by massive healthy flocks of uniquely speckled, spotted, and striped goats and sheep.
